title: How B.Sc. Agriculture undergraduates can plan for ICAR AIEEA-PG and M.Sc. Agronomy
description: A semester-by-semester roadmap for undergraduate agriculture students preparing for M.Sc. Agriculture / Agronomy and ICAR AIEEA-PG admission.
summary: Students aiming for M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Soil Science or Entomology) should verify their undergraduate college’s ICAR accreditation early and align their third- and fourth-year coursework with postgraduate entrance requirements.

sections.heading: Start by confirming your UG degree’s postgraduate eligibility
paragraphs: Many public State Agricultural Universities and the central ICAR AIEEA-PG counselling process stipulate that applicants must graduate from an ICAR-accredited programme or institution. Before or during your undergraduate studies, verify your institution’s status in [how to check ICAR accreditation for an agriculture programme](/articles/icar-accreditation-how-to-check).

Students can also explore postgraduate programmes directly at researched universities offering [M.Sc. Agronomy](/msc-agronomy) and allied specialisations, including [Lovely Professional University](/university/lovely-professional-university), [Siksha ‘O’ Anusandhan](/university/siksha-o-anusandhan), [Centurion University of Technology and Management, Odisha](/university/centurion-university-of-technology-and-management), [ITM University, Gwalior](/university/itm-university-gwalior) and [Tilak Dhari P.G. College, Jaunpur](/university/tilak-dhari-pg-college).

sections.heading: Aligning major subject groups with your thesis interest
paragraphs: Postgraduate entrance tests group closely related disciplines (such as Plant Sciences, Physical Science/Soil Science, Agronomy, Entomology & Nematology, and Social Sciences). Read [choosing an M.Sc. Agriculture specialisation](/articles/msc-agriculture-specialisations) to compare qualifying degrees and research focus before your seventh-semester RAWE attachment.

faqs.question: Is M.Sc. Agronomy a two-year thesis-based programme?
faqs.answer: Yes. Across ICAR-aligned universities, M.Sc. Agriculture (Agronomy) is a four-semester (two-year) postgraduate degree combining advanced coursework, field trials and a research dissertation.

faqs.question: Can a 3-year general B.Sc. graduate apply for M.Sc. Agriculture at all universities?
faqs.answer: Many SAUs and ICAR-aligned programmes specifically require a 4-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture or allied degree. Always check the target university’s postgraduate eligibility table.
